recipes.name: Air Fryer Fried Chicken
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl combine chicken thighs, buttermilk, kosher salt, and pepper. Toss to coat evenly, and let marinate for at least 1 hour, ideally overnight.
In a separate medium mixing bowl, combine all-purpose flour, kosher salt, pepper, and MSG.

Drizzle a few tablespoons of your marinade into the flour mixture and toss to create little balls of dredge. Remove one piece of chicken from the marinade, then toss and press your chicken into the dredge until each piece is fully coated. Repeat with the remaining chicken. Spray chicken with cooking oil before adding it to the air fryer.
Add your chicken to the air fryer and cook for 20 minutes at 350°F (175°C).
